description: Cyclone Tracks (NOAA) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Ocean Data Network. This resource is Cylcone tracks for the periods 2003-2007, 2008-2012, 2013-2017 and 2018-2023 The International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS) provides location and intensity for global tropical cyclones. The data span from the 1840s to present, generally providing data at 3-hour intervals. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Ocean Data Network. Its tags are Climatology. It offers 7 resource(s) in png, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
